_comment: Old-model Domain detection (plan 4.11.6, GDB-09). Read by graph_db's legacy_domain_nodes tests (tests/test_legacy_domain_nodes.py) and the webapp's legacy_graph mirror. Each case seeds `domains` for one tenant and expects `legacy` back for the given `expected` (expectedDomainNames) and `related` (orgs and scan roots). has_subdomain adds a HAS_SUBDOMAIN edge; coverage sets recon_coverage_at. Synthetic names only.

cases.name: a suffix root left by the old batch grouping is legacy
a mixed-case single-domain target is not legacy
the IP-mode mock root is never legacy
an IP-mode project's org Domain of a scanned hostname, with data, is not legacy
a removed root unrelated to the scope keeps its stale semantics
a deeper old root under the current one is legacy
an empty seeded Domain holds no data and is not legacy
